title: phone company sketch - we dont care - Tomlin
summary: Lily Tomlin's classic 1976 Saturday Night Live sketch as telephone operator Ernestine, mocking the monopolistic Bell phone company with the line 'We don't care. We don't have to.' It is a one-minute parody of arrogant corporate indifference.
why: Quoted as the go-to joke whenever a monopoly or big tech company ignores customers, from Verizon to Google to Apple.

quote.text: Like the old SNL sketch, Apple doesn't care. They don't have to.
